basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Head of AI Transformation | AI Strategy & Governance | Hands-On Technical Leader | MBA
basics.summary: Owns AI transformation strategy, governance, and rollout at LumApps; reports directly to C-level on outcomes (production AI agents forecast to generate $4M in approved opportunities per quarter). Six years technical lead at Beekeeper delivering AI products to 10M+ frontline workers across high-availability environments: shipped $1.5M+ in new revenue and eliminated $337K in vendor cost via LLM automation. Three companies founded on the side, plus startup advisory at Tenity including HFT mentoring. MBA, EPFL research background, hands-on with agentic AI and LLMs every day.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns company-wide AI transformation strategy, governance, and sales enablement. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, driving AI adoption across product, sales, CS, and engineering.
highlights: Owns AI transformation strategy and governance across the company. Defines the AI roadmap with ROI metrics, evaluates technology choices, and drives adoption across a matrix organisation. This is the Head of AI Transformation mandate, executed from inside.

Shipped production AI agents for outbound sales: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter, $1M revenue at 25% conversion. AI translated directly into competitive edge.

Built AI Brain, a knowledge-graph context layer (Neo4j, Graphiti, Zep) that grounds production agents in structured business intelligence. Surfaces patterns that drive executive decisions across product, sales, and CS.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead delivering AI products to 10M+ frontline workers in high-availability environments. Drove cost efficiency, speed, and quality at scale across multiple revenue-bearing AI systems.
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated. Operational excellence: cheaper, faster, higher-quality delivery from day one.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. $1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR. Designed for 99.99% SLA: high-availability environments, real customers, real money at stake.

Built multiple production AI systems (AI Onboarding Specialist, GenAI demo generator, Sentiment Analysis) that accelerated product cycles and removed manual gatekeepers. Shipped each with instrumentation and ROI tracking from day one.
Co-owned GTM launches across Product and Sales. Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Change agent across a matrix of three teams; engineers now lead AI features independently.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Strategic advisory for seed-to-VC stage founders. Evaluates AI architecture and advises on AI adoption strategy across portfolio companies.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on AI readiness, architecture, and ROI potential. Findings inform seed-to-VC investment decisions; the closest analog to evaluating and selecting AI technologies at scale.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading in production. Direct exposure to high-availability, low-latency environments where seconds and uptime translate to revenue.

work.name: Obermatt
work.summary: Bridged business and engineering for a Zurich fintech. Owned product roadmap, drove process improvement, and led a remote team in a matrix setup.
highlights: Built strategic roadmaps that improved customer satisfaction and retention. Translated business priorities into engineering execution across a matrix of stakeholders.
Drove process change: agile adoption (productivity up 20%) and CI/CD with Docker (deployment times down 30%). Operational excellence in microcosm.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off building autonomous drone delivery. Owned end-to-end architecture and the safety-critical, high-availability systems that enabled enterprise partnerships.
highlights: Architected end-to-end platform that enabled enterprise partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase. Safety-critical real-time systems with zero tolerance for downtime.
500+ autonomous deliveries; 40% faster, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents. High-availability environment where every flight had revenue and reputation on the line.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at EPFL. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms.
highlights: Engineered Robogen at one of Europe's leading AI labs. Foundational AI work (optimization, search, fitness landscapes) that informs how I evaluate modern LLM and agentic systems today.
Migrated simulation pipeline to AWS; secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics. Supervised 20+ master's students; early reps at translating complex AI concepts to non-expert audiences.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: Head of AI Transformation – Global Sports Betting Technology Provider
_jobApplication.jobDescription: Head of AI Transformation reporting directly to the CEO of a leading global Sports Betting Technology provider. Mandate: design, lead, and execute company-wide AI transformation to radically remake core business functions (operations, support, product dev, software dev), drive operational excellence (cheaper, faster, higher-quality delivery), accelerate product cycles, and create competitive edge. Define AI strategy with ROI metrics, evaluate and select AI tech, define cost-effective architecture, drive adoption across matrix org. Required: large-scale tech/digital transformation leadership with AI/IT automation, software/product/IT engineering background, high-availability environment experience (gaming, trading, payments), deep LLM/agentic AI knowledge, strong communicator, hands-on mindset, comfortable in ambiguity. Sportsbook experience a plus. Search firm: Firinne Solutions.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong match on: AI transformation strategy (LumApps mandate is a 1:1 analog), high-availability experience (Beekeeper 10M+ users, Dronistics safety-critical, Tenity HFT mentoring, PulseView live trading platform), hands-on agentic AI delivery, MBA + EPFL pedigree for CEO-level credibility, three companies founded = change agent. Gaps: no formal 'Head of' title yet (LumApps owns the equivalent scope), no direct sportsbook/gaming experience (PulseView is closest trading analog). Worth flagging the title gap as 'doing the work without the badge' rather than letting it filter you out.
